out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: Cardboard was being used to line the shelves of the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT CARDBOARD CANNOT BE USED TO LINE SHELVING UNITS BECAUSE IT IS NOT EASILY CLEANABLE. BY NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION, PLEASE MAKE SURE TO THROW AWAY ALL CARDBOARD BEING USED TO LINE THE SHELVES IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: raw shell eggs were being stored at room temp next to the flat top.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT EGGS CAN NEVER BE STORED IN AN ENVIRONMENT WHERE THE AMBIENT TEMPERATURE IS 45F OR HIGHER. PIC MOVED THE EGGS TO A PREP TOP COOLER BEHIND FLAT TOP TO PROPERLY COLD HOLD THE EGGS AT 45F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Cans of tuna were being stored on the ground to drain out the liquid from the can.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT FOOD CAN NEVER BE STORED ON THE FLOOR AND MUST ALWAYS BE AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF KF THE GROUND. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE REMOVED THE CANS OF TUNA OFF THE GROUND AND PALCED THEM ON A PREP TABLE TO FINISH DRAINING.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: multiple bulk items being stored in large containers did not have scoops with handles to portion out food items.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL UTENSILS USED TO SCOOPS OUT FOOD ITEMS, MUST HAVE A HANDLES ON THEM SO CONTAMINATION DOES NOT OCCUR.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Single-service containers such as, sour cream containers and old bulk dressing containers, were observed reused for the storage multiple different food items in the restaurant.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items may not be reused. PIC WILL PHASE OUT OLD CONTAINERS BY TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION. PIC ALSO THREW AWAY ALL SINGLE USE CONTAINERS THAT WERE NOT BEING USED TO STORE FOOD IN AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment. Please have your CFM update their certification.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. PIC UNDERSTANDS THERE MUST BE A VALID CFM AT FACILITY AT ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. PIC WILL SEND EHS A PIC OF NEW CERTIFICATE ONCE UPDATED.
